summary: The Agricultural Act of 2026 extends, reforms, and updates agricultural, conservation, trade, nutrition, rural development, research, forestry, and energy programs under the Department of Agriculture through fiscal year 2031.

affected_groups.effect: Subject to updated loan limits, disaster assistance rules, base acre caps, conservation program limits, and new research and grant opportunities.
Benefit from eliminated administrative fees and no premiums for the first 6,000,000 pounds of milk marketings under Dairy Margin Coverage, alongside reauthorized dairy programs.
Experience enhanced EBT card cybersecurity standards, chip-enabled technology requirements, and the addition of hot rotisserie chicken as an eligible food item.
Affected by reauthorized and new rural development programs, including updated broadband standards, water cybersecurity programs, and rural hospital support.

key_provisions: Extends agricultural and nutrition programs, including SNAP and TEFAP, through fiscal year 2031, updating SNAP eligibility to include hot rotisserie chicken and requiring chip-enabled EBT cards.
Adjusts crop and dairy support programs, including eliminating administrative fees for Dairy Margin Coverage and expanding disaster assistance for unweaned livestock, feed, and water shortages.
Reauthorizes and updates conservation programs through 2031, capping the Conservation Reserve Program at 27,000,000 acres and adjusting rental and practice payment limitations.
Increases farm loan limits under the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act, raising direct farm ownership loans to $850,000 and operating loans to $750,000.
Updates rural development and broadband programs, modifying ReConnect Program speed definitions to 100-Mbps downstream and 20-Mbps upstream, and establishing rural health and water programs.

Extends research and forestry provisions through 2031, updating forest inventory requirements, increasing stewardship contracting maximum terms to 20 years, and restricting certain animal research collaborations with specific foreign countries.
